title: Vail Valley Escape Room
specs: Three escape rooms with varying difficulty: beginner, intermediate, advanced
Team building workshops available including warm up, evaluations, and de-brief
Recommended minimum age 6 years; participants 17 and under must be accompanied by an adult 18+
One legal adult (18+) required per adventure
Groups sized 2-10 per adventure; private adventures only
